explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/681: for all large n, is there k with n+k composite and p(n+k) > k², with p the least prime factor? The statement requires k > 0, which is the necessary reading, since k = 0 would make the question trivial for composite n. It asks for n + k composite with its least prime factor (IsLPF) exceeding k², for all large n. Faithful.
